stakeAudit.policy: purchasePoints and investmentYen are not sufficient alone; an explicit per-ticket amount or equal-allocation statement is required.

classCoverageAudit.policy: Only history race className or exact raceKey + frameNo racer-evidence is accepted; names are never matched.

policies: Only leakage-safe exact-order trifecta evaluations are analyzed.
Hit-rate and ROI populations are separate; ROI requires explicit source-backed stake evidence and a same-race official payout.
Miss distance is an ordinal classification only and is not a performance score.
Class backfill requires exact raceKey and frameNo evidence; name matching and fuzzy matching are prohibited.
